stories.headline: Germany rejects Trump's demand for NATO support in Iran War
stories.summary: Chancellor Merz, Defense Minister Pistorius, and Foreign Minister Wadephul unanimously rejected US President Trump's demands for German and NATO military support in securing the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war. German officials stated 'this is not our war' and emphasized NATO is a defensive alliance for member territories only.

articles.title: Wadephul schließt deutsche Beteiligung an Hormus-Mission aus
Merz und Minister: Nato "nicht zuständig" für Straße von Hormus
Iran-Krieg - Pistorius: Keine deutschen Kriegsschiffe in die Straße von Hormus

stories.headline: Government faces criticism over misuse of 500 billion euro special infrastructure fund
stories.summary: Economic institutes found that 95% of Germany's special infrastructure budget was used for purposes other than investment, leading to accusations of mismanagement by Finance Minister Klingbeil. Opposition and former CDU officials call for constitutional challenges and investigations.

articles.title: Zweifelhafte Verwendung des Sondervermögens: Klingbeils Investitions-Milliarden versickern
Kommentar: Für Klingbeil sind die Zahlen zum Sondervermögen verheerend

stories.headline: Federal President Steinmeier visits Latin America and promotes democracy
stories.summary: President Steinmeier conducted visits to Panama, Guatemala, and Mexico to strengthen ties with Latin America. He criticized Trump's policies toward the region and emphasized the importance of democratic values, while also launching Germany's first 'Democracy History Day' initiative.

articles.title: Kritik an Trump: „Lateinamerika ist kein Hinterhof von irgendjemandem
Steinmeier besucht als erster Bundespräsident seit 40 Jahren Guatemala

stories.headline: CDU wins Rhineland-Palatinate state election, ending 35 years of SPD rule
stories.summary: The CDU won the Rhineland-Palatinate state election with 31% versus SPD's 26%, marking the first time since 1991 that the SPD lost control of the state. Chancellor Merz campaigned actively while SPD leaders kept a low profile. The result strengthens Merz's position nationally.

articles.title: Germany news: CDU wins Rhineland-Palatinate election

stories.headline: Revelations of CDU/CSU cooperation with AfD in EU Parliament spark controversy
stories.summary: Reports emerged that CDU/CSU members of the European People's Party collaborated with AfD and other far-right parties in EU Parliament chat groups and meetings on migration policy. Party leaders Merz and Söder distanced themselves and demanded the practice stop.

articles.title: EVP-Kooperation mit AfD im EU-Parlament: Die Union macht sich selbst kaputt – Kommentar
CDU/CSU und AfD: Risse in der Brandmauer

stories.headline: AfD member admits to burning own car and falsely blaming leftists
stories.summary: An AfD member in Bavaria confessed to setting fire to his own vehicle and forging an Antifa threat letter to make it appear like a political attack. The case emerged after handwriting analysis revealed the deception. AfD leadership distanced itself from the incident.

articles.title: Falscher Brandanschlag: AfD-Mitglied zündet eigenes Auto an - und beschuldigt Linke

stories.headline: Defense Minister Pistorius visits Asia to strengthen Indo-Pacific partnerships
stories.summary: Defense Minister Pistorius traveled to Japan, Singapore, and Australia to expand security cooperation and arms industry ties in the Indo-Pacific region. The visit included discussions on rules-based international order and securing maritime routes, with German arms companies accompanying the delegation.

articles.title: Sicherheit, Rüstung, Iran-Krieg: Pistorius besucht Japan
German defence minister to visit Indo-Pacific with arms firms

stories.headline: Bundeswehr reports significant increase in recruitment applications
stories.summary: The German military reported a 20% increase in applications through February 2026, with 16,100 people applying for military careers. The increase is attributed to the new military service law and growing security concerns, with active personnel now at 186,200 soldiers.

articles.title: Plus von 20 Prozent: Bewerbungen bei Bundeswehr nehmen deutlich zu

stories.headline: BND plans new cyber-intelligence center in Bonn
stories.summary: Germany's foreign intelligence service BND plans to expand its Bonn facility into a major Crypto-Cyber-Technology Center focused on artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and hacking capabilities. The expansion reflects Germany's push to modernize its intelligence capabilities.

articles.title: Digital-Spione: Der BND will ein neues Zentrum für Cyberspionage aufbauen

stories.headline: Bundesbank calls for pension reforms and promotes digital euro
stories.summary: The German central bank proposed ending early retirement at 63 and gradually raising retirement age, while also pushing for quick introduction of the digital euro. Bundesbank officials defended keeping German gold reserves stored abroad despite criticism.

articles.title: Bundesbank fordert Renten-Reformen: Aus für Rente mit 63 und höheres Alter
Digitales Geld und Gold: Bundesbank drängt auf digitalen Euro und verteidigt Goldreserven im Ausland

stories.headline: Secret reform negotiations between Chancellor Merz and Vice Chancellor Klingbeil revealed
stories.summary: Reports emerged of secret meetings between Chancellor Merz and Finance Minister Klingbeil to prepare major reforms on taxes, pensions, and social systems. The 'Merz-Klingbeil pact' aims to address Germany's fiscal challenges but faces political risks ahead of eastern state elections.

articles.title: BILD kennt die Details: Der geheime Merz-Klingbeil-Pakt
XXL-Reformen der Bundesregierung: Was Friedrich Merz und Lars Klingbeil kommende Woche verkünden wollen

stories.headline: Finance Minister Klingbeil considers windfall tax on oil companies amid high fuel prices
stories.summary: Finance Minister Klingbeil announced he is examining a windfall tax on oil companies' crisis profits to fund relief for commuters facing high fuel prices due to the Iran war. The proposal includes potentially raising the commuting allowance using revenues from the special tax.
